meta.source: PAI700 final project (Group 10): replay feed, forecast service and twin service, run locally and exported
meta.dataset: SINTEF COFACTOR-SBHUB Oslo school dataset (Lien et al., Data in Brief 63, 112288, 2025), CC BY 4.0
meta.timezone: fixed UTC+1 all year, no daylight saving

model.rule: horizon 1: trees (direct); horizons 6 and 24: average of trees and GRU (residual)

meta.forecast_note: Forecast of the whole building's heat use. The next hours of weather are measured values replayed as a perfect forecast, so real forecast errors are not included: the accuracy is an upper bound.

twin.note: Simulation, not measurement: assumed room parameters, perfect weather forecast and perfect room model for the combined controller (best case), sun converted from horizontal to south facade with one fixed assumed ratio.
